episodes.title: Godflame
episodes.summary: A journey of survival begins when an army of Witchfinders attacks the village of Alkenny.

episodes.title: Message in a Bottle
episodes.summary: A special gift for the twins sparks tension in the group.

episodes.title: Fresh Blood
episodes.summary: The twins struggle to keep a secret from their mother.

episodes.title: The River
episodes.summary: An attack on the village leads to sacrifice and new challenges.

episodes.title: Plastic
episodes.summary: As Tamacti Jun's army nears Baba and family, Maghra's past comes to light.

episodes.title: Silk
episodes.summary: Baba and family are betrayed. Queen Kane uses her cunning to face a new conflict.

episodes.title: The Lavender Road
episodes.summary: The twins reach a crossroads in their journey to the House of Enlightenment.

episodes.title: House of Enlightenment
episodes.summary: The twins meet Jerlamarel and finally discover the truth.

episodes.title: Brothers and Sisters
episodes.summary: Baba ventures into hostile territory in search of Haniwa. Queen Kane consecrates a new Payan capital and makes a surprising announcement.

episodes.title: Forever
episodes.summary: An old enemy comes face-to-face with Baba. Jerlamarel struggles to accept a life without sight.

episodes.title: The Compass
episodes.summary: Edo's leadership is called into question. Baba and Haniwa meet a secret tribe of warriors known as The Compass.

episodes.title: The Witchfinder
episodes.summary: Kofun and Toad arrive in Pennsa just as Maghra makes a life-changing decision. Baba, Paris, and Haniwa run into a trusted friend.

episodes.title: The Dinner Party
episodes.summary: Baba and his family are finally reunited, but his joy is cut short when he learns about the queen's plans.

episodes.title: The Truth About Unicorns
episodes.summary: Maghra, Lord Harlan, and Baba head to the peace summit. Haniwa warns them about Paris' vision. The queen and Kofun spend the day together.

episodes.title: The Queen's Speech
episodes.summary: Queen Kane's treachery forces Maghra's hand. Kofun gets upsetting news. Haniwa makes a final plea to Wren in a bid for peace.

episodes.title: Rock-a-Bye
episodes.summary: Baba and Edo lead their armies into an epic battle that builds to an intense face-off between the brothers.

episodes.title: Heavy Hangs the Head
episodes.summary: Baba embraces life in the mountains as hatred for the sighted grows in Pennsa. A Trivantian scientist develops a terrifying new weapon.

episodes.title: Watch Out for Wolves
episodes.summary: After a devastating loss, Baba heads to Pennsa to warn his family. Maghra debates the Witchfinders' fate. Wren stages a daring escape.

episodes.title: This Land Is Your Land
episodes.summary: Wren arrives in Pennsa and shares information about Tormada's plans. Tamacti Jun tries once more to quell the Witchfinders' insurgency.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.summary: Tormada presents his new weaponry to The Triangle as Baba leads a group to the House of Enlightenment to destroy Tormada's arsenal.

episodes.title: The House of Enlightenment
episodes.summary: A standoff at the House of Enlightenment gives way to a bloody siege between Baba's party and Tormada's soldiers.

episodes.title: The Lowlands
episodes.summary: Baba and his group take a dangerous shortcut through the lowlands to get to Pennsa. Maghra and Tamacti Jun make a horrifying discovery.

episodes.title: God Thunder
episodes.summary: Tormada and Sibeth launch a violent attack on Pennsa that puts Maghra and the city's inhabitants in grave danger.

episodes.title: I See You
episodes.summary: Series finale. Baba and Ranger infiltrate Sibeth's camp, determined to stop her and Tormada once and for all.
